parsed_json.up: Select approved drugs indicated for chronic kidney disease. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_indication on molregno. Filter by max_phase_for_ind = 4 and mesh_heading = 'chronic kidney disease'. Left join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical_smiles. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, efo_id as indication_curie, mesh_heading as indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind.
